findings.impact: The visible preview does not show the selected crop fitted into the output, so the numeric crop and displayed result disagree; image/frame proportions are distorted.

Compute the result from the selected source rectangle x=160,y=90,w=1600,h=900: remove excluded margins, scale the remaining schematic features uniformly to the output target, and clip at the frame. Preserve staged Add destination and Apply/Cancel behavior. Check connected s07 retained output proportions.

limitations: Schematic media is accepted; the two findings concern supported numeric spatial relationships, not photographic fidelity.
Shared renderer system font and fixed22px headings instead of Roboto20px are documented nonblocking limits.
Static scenes do not verify runtime events, keyboard/focus restoration, audio playback, persistence or real media decoding.
Supported child envelopes are part of the exact reviewed subject; their use is not itself a finding.
